rows.screen: customize › ATTRIBUTES & RESOURCES — the HP-from-Vigour derivation, printed
rows.detail: HIS RULE IS PER POINT AND THE SCREEN PRINTS PER TIER. 'vigour shoudl be 1 hp point per' (D17, recorded as overruling the +8) — at VIG 12 the line reads 'HP 84 + 2 tier × 1 = 86': +2, not +12. The rule shipped is 1 per 5-point tier (derivedStats.js pointsPerTier 5). The ledger's F1 evidence is #163 — the RENAME commit, F2's subject: one row's evidence borrowed by the row beside it, the same shape as M7/M2 on 08-08
